density_ratio.rule: left closed, right open; underflow below first edge, overflow at/above last edge

mass_ratio.rule: left closed, right open; 1e-12 boundary margin groups roundoff at ratios 1/3/9

separation_over_radius.rule: active unordered pairs only; r<h; left closed, right open

checks.failure_rule: Abort on changed input/state identity or malformed/missing record. Record all numerical checks; if any fails, suppress aggregate scores globally, export raw failures and exit nonzero. Exit zero means diagnostic implementation/replay gates passed, not predictor accuracy.
checks.rule: Componentwise abs(a-b)<=atol+rtol*max(abs(a),abs(b)). Check dense/local pressure+viscosity=full and diagnostic pair reconstruction=existing full/component acceleration; finite outputs; isolated/outside-support acceleration zero; coincident pressure zero; dense pressure exactly zero if every rho<=rho0; viscous power <=atol+rtol*sum(abs(m*v*a_visc)); net internal force components <=atol+rtol*sum(abs(m*a)); context target local pair unchanged. A nonzero local pressure at rho<=rho0 is a retained model error, not an implementation-gate failure.

context_controls.recipe: Four static states preserve the exact pair 0-1 positions, velocities, masses and material while adding each prefix of neighbours. Compare that pair contribution alone: the local pair law must be unchanged, while the physical law may respond through densities/pressure. Other edges and full net particle forces also change; do not claim an isolated causal contribution to rollout RMSE or impossibility of matching full net forces.

controlled_pair_grid.recipe: 81 static two-particle states; m0=M/(1+R), m1=M-m0; x0=(-r/2,0,0), x1=(r/2,0,0); velocities=(-0.2,0.1,0) and (0.2,-0.1,0). No gravity, time integration, random seed, fit or reserved-test claim. Pressure-only, viscosity-only and combined calls at each state. Keep coincident and at/outside-support controls even with zero pressure/force.

protocol.density_rule: rho_i includes self mass using the same poly6 equation. Record rho_i/rest_density, neighbour-only density contribution, neighbour count and p_i=max(0,k*(rho_i-rho0)). For pair bins use min(rho_i,rho_j)/rho0 and max(m_i,m_j)/min(m_i,m_j). Record both-pressure-zero pairs separately.
protocol.force_rule: At each identical observation, call the unchanged independent dense accelerations and frozen local accelerations with full config, viscosity=0 (pressure), and stiffness=0 (viscosity), all at zero gravity. Decomposition is an offline diagnostic intervention, never an integration step or a change to the saved model. Reconstruct densities and pair forces independently in the new diagnostic module; compare their accumulated accelerations to both existing implementations.
limits: Simplified dimensionless equations, one fixed radius/rest density; no physical water validation.
Old trajectories and correlated static grid controls are diagnostic observations; no fresh blind generalisation estimate.
Pressure and viscosity error vectors can cancel; full RMSE is not the sum of component RMSEs.
No fit, candidate selection, coefficient/feature change, learned density, runtime integration, cost measurement, publication promotion or merge in this diagnostic.
protocol.metrics: Keep pressure, viscosity and full force errors separate. Per particle use acceleration coordinate MSE; per unordered pair use force-on-lower-index coordinate MSE. Report RMSE=sqrt(mean of per-state MSE), with equal weight per state that has members in the named bin and equal weight per particle/pair within that state. Main unconditional summaries have equal scene and checkpoint weight; report per time, material, mass, count, density, neighbour count, separation and mass-ratio bins, with item/state/scene/group counts. Controls are separate. Relative error is RMSE/reference RMS only when reference RMS>1e-12; otherwise null. No confidence intervals, independent-sample claims or causal attribution from bins.
protocol.next_decision: Use these diagnostics to decide whether to predeclare density-aware pressure-threshold and viscosity-denominator features. Any new fit needs a separate protocol and fresh reserved test scenes, keeping the four-coefficient model as a frozen comparator.
protocol.raw_rule: Save all diagnostic observation states, metadata, density/count descriptors and reference/local component accelerations; save per-state pair-bin sufficient statistics and explicit target-pair forces for contextual controls. The saved state plus frozen coefficients/equations reconstruct every pair. Write and actually reload observation/control JSONL through exact expected-identity/state/config and recomputed-diagnostic validation before aggregate generation. Retain checks and failures; no survivor-only means.
protocol.replay_rule: Read all 15 prior initial records, all 15 fine-reference records and the prior evaluation through checksum/identity/completeness gates. Evaluate on every saved reference state. Independently replay only the unchanged local midpoint model for 500 steps at dt=0.002, and require exact state-digest equality with all 90 published local checkpoints before diagnostics. Keep initial states as step 0; main aggregates exclude the three separately reported controls.
protocol.scope: Diagnose the frozen four-coefficient force law. Reused test observations are now diagnostic data, not a new blind evaluation. Preserve every earlier source, model and raw result.
protocol.status: predeclared diagnostic; no fit, model selection or accuracy promotion
